profile.visual_desc: Muscular male with green hair and a grey headband. Wears a blue face mask, dark grey pauldrons, a blue tabard, and olive green trousers with brown leg wraps.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Focused gaze above a dark blue face mask. Green spiky hair sits under a metallic headband. Expression is stern and ready for combat.
profile.weapon_desc: Straight-bladed sword held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Standing in a wide, low isometric stance facing down-right. Sword is held diagonally across the torso with both hands.
profile.step2_windup: Character raises the sword vertically above the head, coiling muscles for a powerful downward strike.
profile.step3_impact: Swings blade downward. A large, bright yellow-to-orange curved energy arc appears, tracing the vertical path of the weapon.
profile.step4_finish: Sword rests at the bottom of the swing. The golden energy trail thins and vanishes as the character holds the follow-through.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 correctly follows the high-to-low vertical trajectory of the sword swing shown in the sprite.

evaluation.diagnosis: Maintains consistent perspective and grip. VFX timing is delayed and shape is circular rather than following the vertical reference arc.
